statement: src/service reports zero new literal-guideline and decision-boundary violations, service-lifecycle-operations is structurally consolidated enough for the global source duplication ratchet to pass at or below its committed baseline without baseline changes, and focused service behavior remains green.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not raise, weaken, or bypass literal, decision-boundary, duplication, lint, metric, or test baselines and gates.
Preserve installable artifact resolution, external manifest normalization, and lifecycle journal/state behavior while consolidating through named constants, owner tables, and structural helpers.
Change only the service owner source and deterministic focused tests needed for this result; do not change Solver implementation, generated shards, roadmap surfaces, or unrelated owners.
